verification.note: GitHub Actions run 31637903158 is green for the v1.16.1 targeted contracts and full maintained regression suite. Retry Failed now retries an update only when the current package version and commit exactly match the failed revision; if the source changed, the owner is sent back to manual diff/confirmation instead of silently applying a newer revision. GitHub import also reuses task-local discovery, validates callback-safe manifests, avoids per-file Contents API calls for public packages, reserves disk for the temporary ZIP, and reports explicit rate-limit failures. VK first-publication failures are retryable without back-posting historical books that have no VK audit state. Bulk import isolates failures per package. Live account-dependent checks still require deployment; no production books are fabricated by QA.

name: GitHub import and cross-platform release hardening
